---
"@pantoken/vitepress-sidebar-toggle": patch
---

Fix `SidebarToggle.vue` rendering its button even on layouts without a sidebar (e.g. `layout: home`
or `sidebar: false` frontmatter). It now uses VitePress's own `useLayout().hasSidebar` to render
and mount only when a sidebar is actually present.

data.content: `SidebarToggle.vue` now uses VitePress's own `useLayout().hasSidebar` composable to gate rendering: the button won't mount (or insert itself into the navbar) when the current page has `layout: home`, no sidebar items, or `sidebar: false` in frontmatter. Added a test asserting the guard and a changeset.
